name: Creating Space Off the Dribble
summary: Use retreat dribbles to beat pressure, create room for pull-ups and finishes, then hold your handle while tired.

drills.name: Retreat Dribble Resets
drills.summary: Back out of pressure with control, then attack again.
steps: Start at half court in a low stance, ball in your right hand.
Take two hard dribbles forward.
Push back with two retreat dribbles. Keep your body between the ball and an imaginary defender.
Cross over and attack forward again.
Do 90 seconds right hand, then 90 seconds left hand.

drills.name: Retreat-Step Pull-Ups
drills.summary: Create a shot with one retreat dribble and rise balanced.
steps: Start at the elbow, facing the rim from 18 feet.
Attack two dribbles toward the rim.
Plant hard, then take one retreat dribble back.
Gather on balance and shoot a pull-up jumper.
Rotate to the other elbow and both wings every 4 shots.

drills.name: Back-Out Blow-By Finishes
drills.summary: Back the defender off, then blow by when they relax.
steps: Start on the wing at the three-point line.
Take one retreat dribble and lift your eyes like you're shooting.
Explode with a long first step to the rim.
Finish with the outside hand off the glass.
Alternate wings each rep and switch hands.

drills.name: Dribble-Back Sprint Ladders
drills.summary: Sprint with the ball and retreat with control while your legs burn.
steps: Start on the baseline with the ball.
Speed dribble to the free throw line, then retreat dribble back to the baseline.
Speed dribble to half court, then retreat dribble back.
Speed dribble to the far baseline, then retreat dribble back.
Rest 20 seconds and repeat until time is up.
